name: Tasarruf Mevduatı Sigorta Fonu (Savings Deposit Insurance Fund, TMSF)
note: Turkish public legal entity with administrative and financial autonomy, acting under the Banking Law No. 5411 (tmsf-public-institution). Among its duties is trusteeship (kayyum): running companies whose management a court has transferred to it during investigations (gain-tmsf-trusteeship). Modelled under the Republic of Türkiye as the state above it; the fund is not a ministry department.
